comments.text: We had an amazing time. Our bay host was friendly and kept checking on us. The kids loved the games and we will definitely be back.
Our screen stopped tracking shots for a few minutes, but an employee came over right away and fixed it. Great experience overall.
Golf was fun and the staff was nice. Food took longer than we expected and was a little expensive, but we still had a good time.
We waited a long time for our food and one order was wrong. Our server was very helpful and replaced it quickly.
The bay equipment kept having problems and we had to ask for help several times. It was never completely fixed and we lost quite a bit of playing time.
